title: KLH/BPLH station PM2.5 component ISPU, 29 October 2026 16:00 source local time
referencePeriod: 2026-10-29 16:00:00 (source-displayed local time; timezone not explicitly printed on detail card)
updateFrequency: Hourly publication under official ISPU explanation; actual per-site uptime unknown.
missingness: Five usable displayed PM2.5 component indices across five associated regions. The sixth inspected site, Kabupaten Bogor Tegar Beriman, displays zero, but zero validity and missing-value semantics were not established; it is excluded rather than treated as zero pollution. No 2023 time series, validated annual concentration mean or completeness rate is available.
definition: The source's PM2.5-specific pollutant index displayed beneath KATEGORI on the station detail card. It is distinct from the maximum multi-pollutant ISPU and is not PM2.5 mass concentration.
measurementMethod: Published PM2.5 concentration-to-ISPU conversion under Permen LHK 14/2020; transcribe the displayed component index without inversion to concentration. Regulatory monitoring basis is continuous 24 hours; actual station valid-hour counts and QA are unavailable.
licenseOrUsageNotes: No explicit prohibition found for narrow attributed transcription of publicly displayed factual readings; no open-data licence identified. This does not grant bulk application/data-service redistribution. Only selected visible source facts are retained, without keys, scripts, headers or cookies.

comparability.reason: Common pollutant and displayed timestamp do not resolve site placement, calibration, valid hours or representativeness. Preserve factual source receipts only; no regional ranking, historical replay guarantee or 2023 comparison.

temporalWarning: 29 October 2026 snapshot only. Not 2023, not an annual average, and not comparable with 2023 profile values.
limitations: Five sites associate with five regions; no population or municipal exposure estimate.
No back-calculation of concentration from rounded indices.
No direct comparison with BMKG concentration values or administrative IKU.
PM2.5-specific index can differ from the station's reported overall ISPU: Leuwiliang is driven by O3 and Sukamahi by PM10.
Live source URLs change; the preserved receipt records this specific timestamp.
knownBiases: Instrument calibration, local conditions and missing hours are undocumented for these observations.
An index is a transformed short-window measure, not annual mean exposure.
safeStatements: At the named site and stated 2026 timestamp, the official PM2.5 component ISPU was the transcribed value.
This dimensionless PM2.5 component is distinct from the site's overall maximum index.
unsafeStatements: This value is PM2.5 in µg/m³.
This is the 2023 annual PM2.5 concentration or regional exposure.
A zero display proves no particulate pollution.
The five region associations establish complete municipal monitoring.
statementTemplates: At {siteName}, the PM2.5 component ISPU was {value} at {period}; this is a dimensionless site index, not a concentration or regional exposure estimate.

sources.evidence: Rendered public station detail showed overall ISPU 86, category SEDANG, critical pollutant PM2.5, and timestamp 29 Oktober 2026 16:00:00. Browser reload was required after changing the station route, followed by waiting for the correct station name; stale route content was discarded.

sources.title: Indeks Standar Pencemar Udara sebagai informasi mutu udara ambien di Indonesia
sources.representation: Researcher-authored audit receipt with attributed metadata/short excerpts
sources.evidence: Official explanation distinguishes dimensionless site-specific ISPU from concentrations and lists PM10, PM2.5, NO2, SO2, CO, O3 and HC. PM2.5 results are published hourly; other parameters at least at 09:00 and 15:00. Existing local primary-law excerpt was also read narrowly: Permen LHK 14/2020 Article 6 uses continuous 24-hour monitoring, and Article 7 requires completeness checks and removal of abnormal observations. Those requirements do not certify completeness or calibration of these six live site readings.
excerpts: ISPU merupakan angka tanpa satuan, digunakan untuk menggambarkan kondisi mutu udara ambien di lokasi tertentu
Hasil perhitungan ISPU parameter PM2.5 disampaikan kepada publik tiap jam selama 24 jam.
sources.retrievalMethod: Native reader on current official explanatory page; targeted jq selection of legal duration and quality-control lines in prior air-exposure audit. Current BPK canonical regulation record confirms the rule remains in force; direct PDF retrieval returned 403.

sources.publisher: JDIH BPK; Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup dan Kehutanan
sources.title: Permen LHK Nomor 14 Tahun 2020 tentang Indeks Standar Pencemar Udara
sources.representation: Researcher-authored audit receipt with attributed metadata/short excerpts
sources.evidence: Current canonical legal record states status Berlaku, enactment 13 July 2020 and effective date 15 July 2020. The linked PDF failed with 403 in this retrieval. Source law sets methodology, not station-specific data completeness.
sources.retrievalMethod: Native reader on canonical regulation record. No challenge links, headers or signed URLs retained.
